_comment: An example SDK profile for `neutraltest sdk --sdk examples/sdk-profile.json`.
Fill the windows from the release your accelerator vendor publishes.
`pytorch_support` is optional and replaces the bundled snapshot of
PyTorch's own support table when present.
A component with `probe` reports its own version once the module is already
imported; one without it is judged by the declared version.

profile.name: example-sdk-2.13
profile.notes: a release certified against torch 2.13 on python 3.10-3.12
